sources.title: 180 Water Street #312 — RentHop historical listing
sources.excerpt: Factual summary (not a quotation): Archived lease takeover with gross and net rent, a concession, known fees, and unit amenities. Body still invites immediate occupancy. RentHop recommendations are separate properties. Scope: exact unit 312. Provider: Parallel; Exa fallback. Historical terms: $4,992 gross; $4,730 advertised net; original 19 months with one free; $65 monthly amenities per leaseholder; $20 per applicant; $4,992 deposit. Unit description claims 610 sq ft. Parallel returned an older snapshot despite live fetch being allowed. TinyFish refresh was bot-blocked. Exa returned the same historical status and core terms; its acquisition time was not supplied.

findings.title: Historical status
findings.detail: Expired page status and immediate-move-in body text coexist. Current availability is unknown; request a current unit-specific offer before acting.

findings.title: Concession eligibility
findings.detail: The original lease average does not establish the effective rent for a new takeover renter. Request remaining term, concession schedule, and written transfer terms.

findings.title: Conflicting pool claims
findings.detail: Building marketing advertises a pool; RentHop building narrative denies one. Prefer the building's direct statement for advertised amenities, but actual operation and access conditions remain unknown.

findings.title: Search excerpt contamination
findings.detail: The initial search excerpt mixed in $4,795 and 577 square feet from nearby unit 3109 at 116 John Street. The full listing separates that recommendation from apartment 312. Those figures are excluded from this report’s cost and size claims.

findings.title: Official record counts
findings.detail: HPD sections returned errors. A browser summary reported counts, but follow-up extraction could not confirm them. Complaint and violation totals remain unknown. This does not establish a clean record or tell us the condition of apartment 312.

findings.title: Building identity matched; unit condition not assessed
findings.detail: The supplied official records associate 180 Water Street with HPD building 29370, BIN 1001134 and BBL 1000700032. The historical city list corroborates identity only. These identifiers do not verify unit 312’s condition or current compliance.

findings.title: Flex permission and full costs remain open
findings.detail: A flex-bedroom claim is not unit-specific permission. Electricity, insurance, takeover charges, concession entitlement and deposit-transfer terms need written confirmation. Historical advertised costs are incomplete.
